data.one_liner: Apply input masks to TextFields, TextFormFields, and Strings easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides input formatters for text fields and utility methods to format raw strings using customizable masks. Supports multi-mask patterns, placeholders, and cursor management.
use_when: You need to format user input in TextFields such as phone numbers, currencies, or documents.
You want to format arbitrary strings using custom mask patterns.
avoid_when: You need complex form state validation beyond simple text masking.
strengths: Supports multi-masking based on input length
Handles cursor position control during typing
Supports reverse masks for currency formatting
weaknesses: Limited to text formatting and masking utilities
